units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:13">Midr. Till. to Ps. I, 1</cite> <he>מכאן שהיה ליי׳</he> (ed. Bub. <he>לי׳</he>) this proves that the serpent was an irreverent talker.—Pl. <he>לֵיצָנִים</he>, <he>לֵיצָנִין</he>, <cite ref="L00514"><he>לֵצָ׳</he></cite>.
